A network monitoring system records the packet loss percentage of a router every minute. During a congestion event, the packet loss first increases and after reaching a peak it decreases as the network stabilizes. Thus the array [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im3.webp|inline] of packet loss values is bitonic (strictly increasing followed by strictly decreasing). The administrator wants to detect the minute when packet loss was maximum using an O(log n) algorithm based on binary search. Suppose we examine the middle element [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im4.webp|inline] . Let, [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im5.webp|inline] (left neighbor) [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im6.webp|inline] (right neighbor) Which of the following facts allow us to correctly narrow the search space?
options: If [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im7.webp|inline] , then x is the peak congestion value.
If [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im8.webp|inline] , then the peak congestion lies in the right half of the array.
If [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im9.webp|inline] , then the peak congestion lies in the left half of the array.
If [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im10.webp|inline] , then the peak congestion lies in the left half of the array.
If [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im11.webp|inline] , then the peak congestion lies in the right half of the array.
correct_answer: If [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im7.webp|inline] , then x is the peak congestion value.
If [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im8.webp|inline] , then the peak congestion lies in the right half of the array.
If [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4010_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im10.webp|inline] , then the peak congestion lies in the left half of the array.
